lines.t: I have indeed lifted up My voice
to this lost and dying generation,
I have spoken plainly to My people,
yet few have ears to hear,
Thus only those who seek that which is first,
Who fill themselves up with that which is most needful,
Will finish the day with strength enough to face tomorrow...
Therefore seek Me out at every opportunity,
Whether for a moment or for the hour,
That you may be renewed in My presence,
Looking always to The Blessed Hope,
Having tasted of it while in waiting...
